entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angelic avenger who demands unwavering loyalty from her troops.

entities.name: Phage the Untouchable
entities.description: A Cabal being who speaks of goblins' price and the Cabal's nectar.

entities.name: Furt
entities.description: A goblin people throw at enemies.

entities.name: Ancestor
entities.description: The deity to whom life is owed.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact whose power affects invokers and mutates Krosa.

entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: A project of wizards whose sliver experiments ran loose.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Creatures that escaped the Riptide Project and overran Otaria.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: A city where wizards sell secrets.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A plane where fewer slivers ever lived than now nest in Otaria.

events.summary: The first sliver slips out of Riptide in the form of a junior researcher.
events.quote: Taking the form of a junior researcher, the first sliver slipped out of Riptide.

events.summary: The slivers break free of the Riptide Project and adapt to life on Otaria.
events.quote: After breaking free from the Riptide Project, the slivers quickly adapted to life on Otaria

events.summary: The Riptide Project loses control of its last slivers and the island is overrun.
events.quote: there was nothing to keep the island from being completely overrun.

events.summary: More slivers nest in Otaria within weeks than ever existed on Rath.
events.quote: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

events.summary: The Mirari's mutating effects grow out of control and centaurs and druids flee.
events.quote: As the Mirari's mutating effects grew out of control, centaurs and druids fled

events.summary: Akroma asks her troops for unwavering loyalty.
events.quote: Akroma asked for only one thing from her troops: unwavering, unconditional loyalty.
